name: Tarocchini
summary: Bolognese 62-card tarot partnership trick-taker with meld declarations before and after play and limited signals.
rules_text: Played with 62-card Tarocco Bolognese. In Ottocento, four play as two opposite partnerships. Deal 15 each in threes, dealer takes last two then discards two non-counters. Before play players may declare melds: three/four of a kind (cricche) and runs of 3+ cards for 10+5 per extra, using Fool and Magician as wild contatori with restrictions; declared combin­ations are shown face up. Then play 15 tricks counter-clockwise, must follow suit or trump if possible; Fool is an excuse kept by its owner who later gives a low card to trick winner if opponent. Capturing Begato and last trick bonus matters. After play count melds found in captured cards, add declaration melds, add trick points counted in pairs minus one per pair plus 6 for last trick. First partnership to 800 cumulative points wins; partners may use three defined visual signals during play.
rating_reason: Point trick-taking tarot, complex but turn-based hidden information.
